name: finsplore
description: Ask your AI assistant about your Finsplore ledger: accounts, spending, budgets, goals and net worth. Six skills plus the Finsplore connection. Australia only. General information, not financial advice.

interface.longDescription: Ask about your accounts, spending, budgets, goals and net worth. Review a month, check budgets, categorise transactions, track goals, test FIRE what-ifs and import statements. Finsplore is for Australians. It gives general information only, not personal financial advice, and it does not move money. Changes are proposals that need approval.
